units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 52a:9">Snh. 52ᵃ</cite> <he>פתילה של א׳</he> a string (bar) of lead.
<cite ref="Chullin 8a:4">Ḥull. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ מעיקרו</he> lead directly from the mine (hot).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:39">Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵇ</cite> bot.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 14:5">Kel. XIV, 5</cite> <he>הא׳ שבצד וכ׳</he> the lead hanging down from the neck of the animal (as ornament or mark).
<cite ref="Gittin 19a">Git. 19ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 104b:4">Sabb. 104ᵇ</cite> <he>כתבו בא׳</he> if he wrote the document with lead (solution); a. fr.
